title: TermAl sqlite has grown to 915MB with no session retention
outcome:
~/.termal/termal.sqlite is 915MB (plus a 52MB WAL) on a real user machine. 674 session records hold 480MB of value_json; the largest single session is 132MB and the next is 65MB, i.e. full transcripts (including tool output and diffs) are stored inline in the session blob with no cap.

Contributing factors:
- 530 of the 674 sessions are delegation children. They are correctly hidden from the list and correctly cascade-deleted with their parent, but nothing removes them when the DELEGATION ITSELF completes, so every /review-with-delegate run leaves 2 permanent records for as long as the parent session lives.
- No retention/pruning of sessions or transcripts anywhere (state_inner.rs has retain_sessions but only delete paths call it).

Whole-blob-per-session storage also means any touch of a 132MB session rewrites 132MB.

Decide a retention policy: cap/offload transcripts, and/or reap completed delegation children after some window (they are inspectable while the review is being read, then disposable).
